subject: general
question: In February 2022, India became the first country in the world to play ________ One Day International cricket matches.
solution:
The correct answer is__ '**1000'**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **International Cricket Council** organizes international cricket matches between teams representing different countries (ICC). Test matches, One-Day matches, and Twenty20 matches are the three main formats.
 
• The **Indian cricket team** became the first squad in history to play **1,000 One-Day Internationals **on February 6.
 
• Two **ODI** World Cups and one **T20** World Cup have been won by the side. India has won **519** games out of the 1000 ODIs they have played thus 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India played its 1000th One-Day International on **Sunday**, becoming the first team to do so. The team accomplished the milestone when playing the **West Indies** in the current first ODI at the **Narendra Modi Stadium**.
 
• **Cricket** is an outdoor sport in which two teams compete. By hitting a ball with a **wooden bat**, players attempt to score points, known as **runs**.
